name: peerlink
description: Lets your Claude agents discover and message each other through one lightweight daemon per machine, with a CLI and a signed-in web UI.

system_prompt.title: Guidance in the system prompt
system_prompt.description: Put peerlink's guidance for agents in the system prompt. peerlink turns this off by itself when another plugin, such as an organisation's managed one, skips that hook; the guidance then goes with each prompt instead.
